English: The current study was conducted to investigate the reproductive toxicity of sodium metavanadate (SMV) in male African giant rats.
Luganda: Okunoonyerezakuno kwakolebwa n’ekigendererwa eky’okunoonyereza obulabe ekirungo kya sodium metavanadate (SMV) bwe kirina ku buzaazi bw’emmese ensolima.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí lọ́ọ́lọ́ náà jẹ́ ṣíṣe láti ṣe ìwádìí iwọ ìbísí ti sódíọ́mù mẹtafẹ́nádéètì (SMV) nínú àwọn akọ òkété.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwamanje lwenziwe ukuze kuphenywe ubuthi bokuzala be-sodium metavanadate (SMV) kumagundane angama-giant Afrika.
Hausa: An gudanar da binciken na yanzu don bincikar ƙarfin gubar haifuwa na sodium metavanadate (SMV) a cikin Ɓerayen Dinka.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di dirilwe ka nepo ya go nyakišiša go ikoketša ga mpholo wa sodium metavanadate (SMV) go magotlomagolo a dipholwana a Afrika.
Amharic: የአሁኑ ጥናት የተካሄደው የሶዲየም ሜታቫናዴት (ሶ.ሜ.ቫ) የመራቢያ መርዛማነትን በአፍሪካ ግዙፍ ወንድ አይጦች ላይ ለመመርመር ነው።

English: Administration of SMV was done intraperitoneally daily for 14 consecutive days at a dosage of 3mg/kg body weight.
Luganda: Ekirungo kya SMV kyakubibwanga emmese mu kabutobuto buli lunaku okumala ennaku 14 ez’omuddiriŋŋanwa ku kipimo kya 3 mg/kg eky’obuzito bw’omubiri.
Yoruba: Ìṣákóso SMV jẹ́ ṣíṣe pẹ̀lú gbígba abẹ́rẹ́ sínú lójoojúmọ́ fún ọjọ́ 14 lérawọn pẹ̀lú ìwọ̀n 3 mg/kg fún ìlóòrìn ara.
Zulu: Ukusetshenziswa kwe-SMV kwenziwa nge-intraperitoneally nsuku zonke izinsuku ezingu-14 ezilandelanayo ngesilinganiso se-3 mg/kg isisindo somzimba.
Hausa: An bayar da SMV a cikin kowace rana na tsawon kwanaki 14 a jere cikin yawa na 3 mg/kg ga nauyin jiki.
Northern Sotho: Go di fa SMV go dirilwe ka dithong tša ka mpeng letšatši le lengwe le le lengwe mo matšatšing a go latelana a 14 ka selekanyo sa 3 mg/kg go boima bja mmele.
Amharic: ለ14 ተከታታይ ቀናት በየቀኑ በ1ኪ.ግ 3 ሚ.ግ የሰውነት ክብደት መጠን ልኬት በውስጠ መርመሬ ሶ.ሜ.ቫን የመስጠት ሂደት ተከናውኗል።

English: Sterile water was administered to the control group.
Luganda: Amazzi amapakire agakozesebwa mu kukuba empiso gaakubibwa ekibinja ekifuge.
Yoruba: Omi tí kò lábàwọ́n jẹ́ lílò ní ọ̀wọ́ àyẹ̀wò.
Zulu: Amanzi angenalutho anikezwe iqembu lokulawula.
Hausa: An bayar da tsabtataccen ruwa ga rukunin kulawar.
Northern Sotho: Meetse a go seterelaeswa a tšhetšwe go sehlopha seo se laolwago.
Amharic: የጸዳ ውሃ ለመቆጣጠሪያ ቡድን ተሰጥቷል።

English: We analyzed serum reproductive hormones, sperm reserve and quality as well as testicular ultrastructural changes following SMV treatment.
Luganda: Twekaliriza obusimu obuzaazi obuli mu lusaayisaayi, enkwaso eziterekebwa n’omutindo gwazo awamu n’enkyukakyuka mu kikula ky’ensigo oluvannyuma lw’okukuba emmese ekirungo kya SMV.
Yoruba: A ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ àwọn hòmóònù ìbísí omi ara, ìpamọ̣́ àti ìwọ̀n ìdára àtọ̀ tí ó fi mọ́ àwọn ìyípada ipò ẹpọ̀n nínú láti ara itọju SMV.
Zulu: Sihlaziye amahomoni okuzala e-serum, ukugcinwa kwesidoda kanye nekhwalithi kanye nezinguquko ze-ultrastructural yamasende ngemva kokwelashwa kwe-SMV.
Hausa: Mun nazarci ƙwayoyin halittar ruwan jini na haihuwa da ajiyar maniyyi da inganci gami da canje-canjen ultrastructural na testicular bayan jiyyar SMV.
Northern Sotho: Re ile ra sekaseka dihomoune tša go ikoketša tša seramo, tekano ya disepeme le boleng bja tšona ga mmogo le diphetogo tša sebopegotlaleletšo ka morago ga go a fa SMV.
Amharic: የሶ.ሜ.ቫ ህክምናን ተከትሎ የእዥ መራቢያ ሆርሞኖችን፣ የወንዴ ዘር ክምችት እና ጥራትን እንዲሁም የወንዴ ዘር እጢ ውስጥ አልትራ መዋቅራዊ ለውጦችን ተንትነናል።

English: Our results showed SMV exposed AGR group had statistically increased progesterone but decreased testosterone, FSH and LH concentrations.
Luganda: Bye twazuula byalaga nti ekibinja AGR ekyakubibwa ekirungo kya SMV kyeyongera okufuna progesterone naye ate testerone, FSH ne LH ne bukendeera.
Yoruba: Àwọn àbájáde wa ṣàfihàn pé SMV ọ̀wọ́ AGR SMV tí a tú síta ti mú àlékún bá èròjà apèsè-ẹyin-fábo ṣùgbọ́n ó ń mú àdínkù bá èròjà-amákọbàlágà, FSH àti àwọn àpòpọ̀ LH.
Zulu: Imiphumela yethu ibonise ukuthi iqembu le-SMV elidaluliwe le-AGR lalikhuphule i-progesterone ngokwezibalo kodwa lehla ukugxila kwe-testosterone, i-FSH ne-LH.
Hausa: Sakamakonmu ya nuna SMV da aka bayyanar ga rukunin AGR ya haɓaka haɓakar ƙwayoyin sarrafa haila a ƙididdigar amma ta rage tattaruwar testaron, FSH da kuma LH.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša rena di laeditše gore ge SMV e filwe sehlopha sa AGR e oketša phrotšesteroune kudu eupša ya fokotša bontši bja thestosteroune, FSH le bja LH.
Amharic: ውጤታችን እንደሚያሳየው ለሶ.ሜ.ቫ የተጋለጠ የአ.ግ.አ ቡደን ፕሮጄስትሮን በስታትስቲካዊ መልኩ ጨምሯል ነገር ግን የቴስቶስትሮን፣ FSH እና LH መጠኖች ቀንሰዋል።

English: Also, SMV treated group had statistically decreased sperm motility and mass activity with increased percentage of abnormal morphophenotypes of spermatozoa and upregulation of P53 immunopositive cell.
Luganda: N’ekirala, ekibinja ekyakubibwa ekirungo kya SMV kyaddirira mu ntambula y’enkwaso olw’okweyongera kw’ebika by’enkwaso eziriko obulemu awamu n’okutumbuka kw’akataffaali akayitibwa P53 immunopositive cell.
Yoruba: Bákan náà, ọ̀wọ́ SMV tí a ti ṣètọ́jú ti mú àdínkù bá ìṣíkiri àtọ̀ àti ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìṣe pẹ̀lú ìgbésóke iye ìwọ̀n àwọn àkojọ-àbùdá-ìjọni abaàdì àwọn àtọ̀ àti ìgbésókè P53 àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì tó nímìí.
Zulu: Futhi, iqembu elilashwa nge-SMV liye lehle ngokwezibalo ukuhamba kwesidoda kanye nomsebenzi omkhulu ngamaphesenti andayo e-morphophenotypes engavamile ye-spermatozoa kanye nokulawulwa kwe-P53 immunopositive cell.
Hausa: Har wa yau, rukunin da aka yi wa SMV ta ƙididdige raguwar motsin maniyyi da yawan aiki tare da ƙara yawan morphophenotypes na spermatozoa mara kyau da haɓakar ƙwayoyin rigakafi na P53.
Northern Sotho: Gape, sehlopha seo se filwego SMV se bile le phokotšego ya go hwa ga disepeme le go gola ga boima bja mmele fao go bilego le persente ye e pketšegago ya mehutapopego ye e sego ya tlwaelega ya tlhamego ya disepeme le ya taologodimo ya disele tša imunophosethifi ya P53.
Amharic: እንዲሁም በሳ.ሜ.ቫ የታከመ ቡድን ከወንዴ ዘር ህዋስ ያልተለመዱ ክስት ባህሪያት እና ቅርጾች በመቶኛ መጨመር ጋር እና ከP53 አዎንታዊ ምላሽ የሚሰጥ ህዋስ ውስጠ ክፍሎች መባዛት ጋር በስታትስቲካዊ መልኩ የቀነሰ የወንዴ ዘር እንቅስቃሴ እና የጅምላ እንቅስቃሴ ነበረው።

English: Ultrastructural study revealed vocuolation of germ and Sertoli cells, cytoplasmic and nucleus; and mitochondrial swelling and vacuolations were also observed.
Luganda: Okwekaliriza ekikula ky’obutaffaali kwayoleka nti waaliwo omuwaatwa mu butaffaali germ ne sertoli obuvunaanyizibwa mu kukola enkwaso; kw’ossa okulungula kw’olububi lw’obutaffaali ate ne lulabirwamu n’omuwaatwa.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí ìfẹ̀rọwònú ṣàfihàn ìkórajọ àwọn kòkòrò àti ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì Sẹ̀tólì, saitopílámíìkì àti hóró àárín; bákan náà wíwú àti ìkórajọ maitokọ́ńdíríà náà jẹ́ kíkíyèsí.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwe-Ultrastructural lwembula i-vocuolation yegciwane kanye namaseli e-Sertoli, i-cytoplasmic ne-nucleus; kanye nokuvuvukala kwe-mitochondrial kanye nokukhishwa kwe-vacuols nakho kwabonwa.
Hausa: Nazarin ultrastructural ya bayyana vocuolation na germ da ƙwayoyin Sertoli da cytoplasmic da nucleus; an kuma lura da kumburin mitochondrial da kuma vacuolations.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo ka ga tlhamego ya disele di utollotše tlhamego ya dibakhule tša ditwatši le ga disele tša Sertoli tša saethopholasemo le tša nyutlelease; le go kokomoga ga maethokhontriale le tlkhamego ya dibakhule le yona e ile ya bonwa.
Amharic: አልትራ መዋቅራዊ ጥናት የጀርም እና ሴርቶሊ ህዋሶች፣ የቤተህዋስ እና ፍሬህዋስ ፊኝት መፈጠርን አሳይቷል፤ እንዲሁም የሃይለህዋሳዊ እብጠት እና ፊኝቶች መፈጠርም ተስተውለዋል።

English: There was severe disintegration of the seminiferous tubules, atrophy and degeneration of myeloid cells and apoptosis of the Leydig, Sertoli and germ cells.
Luganda: Waaliwo okunafuwa kw’obupiira omukolebwa enkwaso, okwonooneka n’okunafuwa kw’obutaffaali obubeera mu busomyo bw’amagumba ssaako okufa kw’obutaffaali Leydig, Sertoli ne germ.
Yoruba: Ìyapa àwọn ẹ̀dọ̀ ẹpọ̀n pọ̀, ìmárarù àti ìdúrólọ́tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì málọ́ìdì àti ìsekú pa àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì Léídéègì, Sẹ̀tólì, àti kòkòkò.
Zulu: Kube nokuhlakazeka okukhulu kwamashubhu eseminiferous, i-atrophy kanye nokuwohloka kwamaseli e-myeloid kanye ne-apoptosis ye-Leydig, i-Sertoli namaseli amagciwane.
Hausa: An sami tarwatsewa mai tsanani na tubules na seminiferous, da nisantar tsoka da lalata ƙwayoyin myeloid da mutuwar sel na Leydig da kum Sertoli da ƙwayoyin cuta.
Northern Sotho: Go bile le go hwelela kudu ga ditšhupu tša go sepetša disepeme, tshenyego le go hwelela ga disele tša maeloete le go hwa ga disele tša Leydig, Sertoli le tša ditwatši.
Amharic: የወንዴ ዘር እጢ ደቂቅ ቱቦዎች ክፉኛ መበታተን፣ የመቅናዊ ህዋሶች ስልላት እና መጫጨት እና የሌይዲግ፣ የሴርቶሊ እና የጀርም ህዋሶች ሂደታዊ የህዋስ ሞት ሂደት ነበር።

English: In conclusion, intraperitoneal SMV exposure exerts severe adverse effects on some serum reproductive hormones, reduction of sperm reserve and quality, apoptosis and degenerative changes of the Leydig, Sertoli and germ cells which can lead to infertility.
Luganda: Mu kuwunzika, ekirungo kya SMV bwe kikubibwa mu kabutobuto kikosa bubi nnyo homoni enzaazi, kikendeeza nnyo enkwaso eziterekebwa n’omutindo gwazo ssaako okuleetawo enkyukakyuka ezitta oba ezinafuya obutaffaali Leydig, Sertoli ne germ eziyinza okuviirako obugumba.
Yoruba: Ní ìparí, ìfihàn gbígba abẹ́rẹ́ SMV sínú ní ipa ìkọlù tí ó lágbára lórí díẹ̀ nínú àwọn hòmóònù ìbísí omi ara, ìdínkù àtọ̀ tí ó wà nílẹ̀ àti ìdára rẹ̀, ìṣekúpa àti àwọn àyípadà ìyapa àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì Léídéègì, Sẹ̀tólì, àti kòkòkò tí ó lè yọrí sí àìlèpamọ.
Zulu: Sengiphetha, ukuchayeka kwe-intraperitoneal SMV kunemiphumela emibi kakhulu kwamanye amahomoni okuzala e-serum, ukunciphisa ukugcinwa kwesidoda kanye nekhwalithi, i-apoptosis kanye nezinguquko eziwohlokayo ze-Leydig, i-Sertoli namangqamuzana amagciwane okungaholela ekungazali.
Hausa: A ƙarshe, bayyanar SMV na intraperitoneal yana haifar da mummunar tasiri a kan wasu ƙwayoyin halittar jini na haihuwa, raguwar ajiyar maniyyi da inganci, mutuwar sel da canje-canje na lalacewa na Leydig, Sertoli da ƙwayoyin cuta wanda zai iya haifar da rashin haihuwa.
Northern Sotho: Ge re fetša, go fa magotlo SMV ka dithong tša ka teng go tšweletša diabe tše mpe kudu go dihomoune tše dingwe tša tšweletšo ya seramo, go phokotšo ya poloko ya disepeme le go hwa ga disele le diphetogo tša go hwelela ga disele tša Leydig, Sertoli le tša ditwatši gomme se se ka feletša ka go hloka pelego.
Amharic: ለማጠቃለል፣ በውስጠ መርመሬ ለሳ.ሜ.ቫ መጋለጥ በአንዳንድ የእዥ መራቢያ ሆሮሞኖች ላይ ክፉኛ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ማሳደርን፣ የወንዴ ዘር ክምችት እና ጥራት መቀነስን፣ የሌይዲግ፣ የሴርቶሊ እና ጀርም ህዋሶች ሂደታዊ የህዋስ ሞትን እና የመጫጨት ለውጦችን ያስከትላል፤ ይህም ወደ መሃንነት ሊያመራ ይችላል።

English: Researchers found that vanadium, a type of metal, damages rats’ cells and their ability to create offspring (fertility).
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula ng’ekika ky’akuuma akamanyiddwa nga vanadiyamu, kyonoona obutaffaali bw’emmese n’obusobozi bwazo obw’okuzaala (obuzaazi).
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣàwárí pé Fánédíọ̀mù, irú irin kan, máa ń ba ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì àwọn eku jẹ́ àti agbára àti lè bí ọmọ wọn (ìbísí).
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi i-vanadium, uhlobo lwensimbi, ilimaza amangqamuzana amagundane kanye nekhono lawo lokudala inzalo (ukuzala).
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa sinadarin vanadium, wani nau’in ƙarfe, yana lalata ƙwayoyin ɓerayen da kuma ikon su na haifar da zuriya (haihuwa).
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gore banadiamo, e lego mohuta wa metale, o senya disele tša magotlo le go kgona ga tšona go tšweletša magotlwana (go ikoketša).
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች የብረት አስተኔ አይነት የሆነው ቫናዲየም የአይጦችን ህዋሶች እና ዘሮች የመፍጠር ችሎታቸውን (ፍሬአማነት) እንደሚጎዳ ደርሰውበታል።

English: Because this metal is also toxic to humans, they suggest more research to find out if the metal, which is increasingly found in our environment due to pollution, might have similar negative effects on human health.
Luganda: Olw’okuba ng’akuuma kano era ka bulabe eri abantu, bateesa wabeewo okunoonyereza okulala okukolebwa okuzuula oba ng’akuuma ako, akasangibwa ennyo mu mbeerabantu mwe tubeera olw’okugyonoona, kayinza okuba n’obulabe bwebumu eri obulamu bw’abantu.
Yoruba: Nítorí pé irin yìí jẹ́ ìwọ fún àwọn ènìyàn, wọ́n dábàá àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí síi láti wádìí bó yá irin náà, tí à ń sábà rí ní àyíká wa látàrí ìbàjẹ́, lè ní ipa òdì irú rẹ̀ lórí àlàáfíà ènìyàn.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi le nsimbi iphinde ibe nobuthi kubantu, baphakamisa ucwaningo olwengeziwe ukuze bathole ukuthi insimbi, etholakala ngokwandayo endaweni esizungezile ngenxa yokungcola, ingaba nemiphumela emibi efanayo yini empilweni yomuntu.
Hausa: Domin shi ma wannan ƙarfen yana da guba ga ɗan’adam, sun bayar da shawarar a ƙara yin bincike domin gano ko ƙarfen da ake ƙara samunsa a muhallinmu saboda gurɓatar yanayi, zai iya yin illa iri ɗaya ga lafiyar ɗan’adam.
Northern Sotho: Ka gobane metale wo le o na o na le mpholo go batho, ba šišinya gore go dirwe dinyakišišo tše dingwe ge tseba ge eba metale wo, wo gantši o hwetšwago tikologong ya rena ka lebaka la tšhilafatšo, o ka ba le diabe tše di swanago tše mpe go maphelo a batho.
Amharic: ይህ ብረት አስተኔ ለሰዎችም መርዛማ ስለሆነ በብክለት ምክንያት በበለጠ መልኩ በከባቢ አየራችን ውስጥ እየተገኘ የመጣው ብረት አስተኔ በሰው ጤና ላይ ተመሳሳይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ሊያሳድር ስለመቻሉ ለማወቅ ተጨማሪ ምርምር እንዲደረግ ጠቁመዋል።

English: Even though vanadium is a metal, it can enter the air in tiny amounts when fossil fuels, like oil and coal, are burned.
Luganda: Newankubadde nga vanadiyamu kaba kuuma, kasobola okuyingira mu mpewo mu bupapajjo obutono ddala nga ebifutafuta, gamba nga oyiro n’amanda byokyeddwa.
Yoruba: Kódà pẹ̀lú bí Fánédíọ̀mù ṣe jẹ́ irin, ó lè yọ́ sínú afẹ́fẹ́ díẹ̀díẹ̀ nígbà tí àwọn epo eléèéfín bíi epo tàbí kóòlù bá jó.
Zulu: Ngisho noma i-vanadium iyinsimbi, ingangena emoyeni ngamanani amancane lapho kushiswa amafutha, njengamafutha namalahle.
Hausa: Duk da cewa sinadarin vanadium ƙarfe ne, yana iya shiga iska kaɗan a lokacin da aka ƙone man fetur da kuma gawayi.
Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore banadiamo ke metale, o ka tsena moyeng ka ditekano tše nnyane kudu ge dibešwa tša fosilo tša go swana le makhura le malahla, a tšhungwa.
Amharic: ቫናዲየም ብረት አስተኔ ቢሆንም እንደ ዘይት እና ከሰል ያሉ ቅሪተ አካላት ሲቃጠሉ በአነስተኛ መጠን ወደ አየር ሊገባ ይችላል።

English: As the world uses more of these fuel sources, the amount of vanadium pollution increases.
Luganda: Ensi gye yeeyongera okukozesa ebifutafuta bino, ekirungo kya vanadiyamu gye kyeyongera okwonoona empewo.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú bí àgbááyé ṣe ń ṣàmúlò púpọ̀ àwọn orísun epo wọ̀nyìí, ìbàjẹ́ Fánédíọ̀mù ń lé síi.
Zulu: Njengoba umhlaba usebenzisa okuningi kwale mithombo kaphethiloli, inani lokunukubezeka kwe-vanadium liyakhula.
Hausa: Yayin da duniya take amfani da ƙarin waɗannan hanyoyin man fetur, adadin gurɓataccen gurɓataccen sinadarin vanadium yana ƙaruwa.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge lefase le šomiša bontši bja methopo ye ya dibešwa, tekano ya tšhilafatšo ka banadiamo e a oketšega.
Amharic: ዓለም እነዚህን የነዳጅ ምንጮች የበለጠ ሲጠቀም የቫናዲየም ብክለት መጠን ይጨምራል።

English: We already know that people exposed to it can suffer from health problems like anaemia, dry throats and eyes, and chest pains.
Luganda: Tukimanyi bulungi nti abantu abali mu bifo mwe kiri basobola okufuna endwadde gamba nga aneemiya, okukala kw’emimiro n’amaaso, awamu n’okulumizibwa mu kifuba.
Yoruba: A ti mọ̀ tẹ́lè pé àwọn tí wọ́n bá kọ lù ú lè bá ìṣòro ìlera fíra bíi anemíà, ọ̀nà-ọ̀fun àti ojú gbígbẹ, àti àyà dídùn.
Zulu: Siyazi vele ukuthi abantu abachayeka kuyo bangaba nezinkinga zempilo ezifana ne-anemia, umphimbo owomile namehlo, nezinhlungu esifubeni.
Hausa: Mun riga mun sani cewa mutanen da suka kamu da cutar suna iya fama da matsalolin lafiya kamar ƙarancin jan ƙwayar jini da bushewar maƙogwaro da idanu da kuma ciwon ƙirji.
Northern Sotho: Re šetše re tseba gore batho bao e ba fetelago ba ka ba le mathata a maphgelo a go swana le go fela madi, megolo le mahlo tše di omeletšego, le dihlabi tša maswafong.
Amharic: ለእሱ የተጋለጡ ሰዎች እንደ ደም ማነስ፣ የጉሮሮ እና የዓይን መድረቅ እና የደረት ህመም ባሉ የጤና ችግሮች ሊሰቃዩ እንደሚችሉ አስቀድመን አውቀናል።

English: Recently, scientists have also become interested in the effects that vanadium could have on fertility.
Luganda: Gye buvuddeko, bannassaayansi era bettanidde okumanya ekirungo kya vanadiyamu kye kikola ku buzaazi.
Yoruba: Láìpẹ́ yìí àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì tún ti nífẹ̀ẹ́sí àwọn ipa tí Fánédíọ̀mù lè ní lórí ìbísí.
Zulu: Muva nje, ososayensi baye baba nesithakazelo emiphumeleni i-vanadium engaba nayo ekuzaleni.
Hausa: A baya-bayannan, masana kimiyya sun kuma zama masu sha’awar tasirin da sinadarin vanadium zai iya haifarwa ga haihuwa.
Northern Sotho: Mo nakong ye e sa tšwago go feta, bašomi ba tša mahlale le bona ba ile ba ba le kgahlego go diabe tšeo banadiamo e ka bago le tšona go tša pelego.
Amharic: እንዲሁም በቅርቡ ሳይንቲስቶች ቫናዲየም በፍሬአማነት ላይ የሚያስከትላቸውን ተጽእኖዎች ለመረዳት ፍላጎት አሳይተዋል።

English: They’ve started to study these effects in rats, which are often used in the laboratory because of their similarity to humans.
Luganda: Batandise okunoonyereza ku bintu bino ebivaamu nga bakozesa emmese, ezitera okukozesebwa mu kkeberero olw’okufaanana abantu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní wo àwọn ipa wọ̀nyìí lórí àwọn eku tí wọ́n máa ń sábà lò nínú àwọn yàrá àyẹ̀wò nítorí ìjọra wọn pẹ̀lú àwọn ènìyàn.
Zulu: Sebeqalile ukufunda le miphumela kumagundane, avame ukusetshenziswa elabhorethri ngenxa yokufana kwawo nabantu.
Hausa: Sun fara nazarin waɗannan tasirin a cikin ɓerayen, waɗanda galibi ana amfani da su a cikin ɗakin gwaje-gwaje saboda kamanceceniya da mutane.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba thoma go nyakišiša ka ga diabe tše go magotlo, ao gantši a šomišwago ka laporathoring ka lebaka la go swana ga ona le batho.
Amharic: ከሰዎች ጋር ተመሳሳይነት ስላላቸው በላብራቶሪ ውስጥ ብዙ ጊዜ ጥቅም ላይ በሚውሉት አይጦች ላይ እነዚህን ተጽእኖዎች ማጥናት ጀምረዋል።

English: In this study, the scientists were interested in the effects of vanadium on a common type of rat found in West Africa, called the African Giant Rat.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, bannassaayansi baayagala okumanya ekirungo kya vanadiyamu kye kikola ku mmese emanyiddwa ennyo esangibwa mu Bugwanjuba bwa Afirika, eyitibwa emmese ensolima.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì nífẹ̀ẹ́ sí ipa Fánédíọ̀mù lórí oríṣìí eku kan tí ó wọ́pọ̀ tí a lè bá pàdé ní ìhà ìwọ̀-oòrùn Áfíríkà, tí à ń pè ní Òkété.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, ososayensi babenesithakazelo emiphumeleni ye-vanadium ohlotsheni oluvamile lwegundane elitholakala eNtshonalanga Afrika, elibizwa ngokuthi i-African Giant Rat.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masanan sun yi sha’awar tasirin sinadarin vanadium a kan wani nau’in ɓera gama-gari da ake samu a Afirka ta Yamma, wanda ake kira Ɓeran Dinka.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, bašomi ba tša mahlale ba bile le kgahlego go diabe tša banadiamo go mohuta wo o swanago wa magotlo ao a hwetšwago ka Borwa bja Afrtika ao a bitšwago Magotlomagolo a Afrika.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ ሳይንቲስቶች ቫናዲየም በምዕራብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ የአፍሪካ ግዙፍ አይጥ ተብሎ በሚጠራው የተለመደ የአይጥ አይነት ላይ ያለውን ተጽእኖ ለማወቅ ፍላጎት ነበራቸው።

English: They wanted to understand how vanadium changes male rat reproductive systems, specifically their sperm, hormones, and the cells of their testicles.
Luganda: Baayagala okumanya engeri ekirungo kya vanadiyamu gye kikyusaamu omuyungo gw’obuzaazi ogw’emmese ensajja, naddala enkwaso zaazo, homoni, n’obutaffaali bw’ensigo zaazo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fẹ́ ní òye ní Fánédíọ̀mù ṣe ń mú àyípadà bá ètò ìbísí akọ eku, ní pàtàkì, àwọn àtọ̀ wọn, àwọn hòmóònù, àti àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì inú àwọn ẹpọ̀n wọn.
Zulu: Babefuna ukuqonda ukuthi i-vanadium ishintsha kanjani izinhlelo zokuzala zamagundane wesilisa, ikakhulukazi isidoda sabo, amahomoni, namaseli amasende abo.
Hausa: Sun so su fahimci yadda sinadarin vanadium yake canza tsarin haihuwar mazan ɓera, musamman maniyyinsu da ƙwayoyin halitta da kuma ƙwayoyin marainansu.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba nyaka go kwešiša ka fao banadiamo e fetošago tshepedišo ya go ikoketša ga magotlo a dipholwana, kudukudu go disepeme tša ona, go dihomoune, le go disele tša maretšana a tšona.
Amharic: ቫናዲየም የወንድ አይጥ የመራቢያ ሥርዓትን በተለይም የወንዴ ዘራቸውን፣ ሆርሞናቸውን ፣ የወንዴ ዘር እጢዎቻቸውን እና ህዋሳቸውን እንዴት እንደሚለውጥ መረዳት ፈልገው ነበር።

English: The researchers injected 6 male rats with vanadium once a day, for 14 days.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakuba emmese ensajja 6 ekirungo kya vanadiyamu omulundi gumu olunaku, okumala ennaku 14.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí gún àwọn akọ eku 6 lábẹ́rẹ́ Fánédíọ̀mù lẹ́ẹ̀kan lójúmọ́ fún ọjọ́ 14.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bajova amagundane abesilisa angu-6 nge-vanadium kanye ngosuku, izinsuku ezingu-14.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi wa ɓeraye guda 6 allurar sinadarin vanadium sau ɗaya a rana, na tsawon kwanaki 14.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hlabetše magotlo a dipholwana a 6 ka banadiamo gatee ka letšatši, mo matšatšing a 14.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ 6 የወንድ አይጦችን በቀን አንድ ጊዜ ለ14 ቀናት በቫናዲየም መርፌ ወግተዋቸዋል።

English: At the same time, they injected another 6 rats with water as a “control” experiment.
Luganda: Mu kiseera kyekimu, emmese endala 6 baazikuba amazzi ng’ekibinja “ekifuge” mu kugezesa okwakolebwa.
Yoruba: Bákan náà, wọ́n gún àwọn akọ 6 mìíràn lábẹ́rẹ́ omi gẹ́gẹ́ bí “àyẹ̀wò”.
Zulu: Ngesikhathi esifanayo, bajova amanye amagundane angu-6 ngamanzi njengokuhlola “kokulawula”.
Hausa: A lokaci guda, sun yi wa wasu ɓerayen guda 6 allurar ruwa a matsayin gwaji na “sarrafawa”.
Northern Sotho: Ka yona nako yeo, ba ile ba hlabela magotlo a mangwe a 6 ka meetse bjalo ka tekolo ya “taolo”.
Amharic: በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ እንደ “መቆጣጠሪያ” ሙከራ ሌላ 6 አይጦችን በውሃ መርፌ ወግተዋቸዋል።

English: Because water would be unlikely to affect the rats, the researchers could be sure that any changes they saw in the first six rats were the result of the vanadium injections.
Luganda: Olw’okuba amazzi gaali tegasuubirwa kukosa mmese, abanoonyereza baali ba kukakasa nti enkyukakyuka zonna ze bandirabye mu mmese omukaaga ezisooka zandibadde zivudde ku kirungo kya vanadiyamu kye baazikuba.
Yoruba: Nítorí pé omi ṣeéṣe kí ó má nípa lórí àwọn eku náà, àwọn aṣèwádìí ní ìdánilójú pé àyípadà yìówù tí wọ́n bá rí nínú àwọn eku mẹ́fà àkọ́kọ́ jẹ ipa abẹ́rẹ́ Fánédíọ̀mù.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi amanzi angeke athinte amagundane, abacwaningi bangaqiniseka ukuthi noma yiziphi izinguquko abazibona kumagundane ayisithupha okuqala zaziwumphumela wemijovo ye-vanadium.
Hausa: Domin da wuya ruwa ya shafi ɓerayen, masu binciken za su iya tabbatar da cewa duk wani sauye-sauye da suka gani a cikin ɓerayen shida na farko, sakamakon allurar sinadarin vanadium ne.
Northern Sotho: Ka gobane meetse ga go na le klgonagalo ya gore a ka ama magotlo, banyakišiši ba be ba kgona go ba le bonnete bja gore diphetogo dife goba dife tše ba di bonego go magotlo a tshela a mathomo e bile dipoelo tša go hlabelwa ka banadiamo.
Amharic: ምክንያቱም ውሃ አይጦቹ ላይ ተጽእኖ የማሳደር ዕድል ስለማይኖረው ተመራማሪዎቹ በመጀመሪያዎቹ ስድስት አይጦች ላይ ያዩዋቸው ማንናቸውም ለውጦች የቫናዲየም መርፌ ውጤት መሆኑን እርግጠኛ መሆን ችለዋል።

English: After 14 days, they checked if the amount of hormones, like testosterone, had changed, and they examined their testicles and counted their sperm.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma lw’ennaku 14, baakebera okulaba oba ng’obungi bwa homoni gamba nga testerone, bwali bukyuse, era ne beekaliriza ensigo zaazo ne babala enkwaso zaazo.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn ọjọ́ 14, wọ́n wò ó bóyá iye àwọn hòmóònù, bíi èròjà-amákọbàlágà, ti yí padà, wọ́n sì ṣàyẹ̀wò ẹpọ̀n wọn, wọ́n sì ka iye àtọ̀ wọn.
Zulu: Ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-14, babheka ukuthi inani lamahomoni afana ne-testosterone selishintshile yini, base behlola amasende babala isidoda sabo.
Hausa: Bayan kwanaki 14, sun duba ko adadin ƙwayoyin halitta, kamar testaron ya canza, kuma sun bincika marainansu kuma sun ƙidaya maniyyinsu.
Northern Sotho: Ka morago ga matšatši a 14, ba ile ba lekola ge eba tekano ya dihomoune, tša go swana le thestosteroune, e fetogile, gomme ba ile ba hlahloba maretšana a tšona le go bala disepele tša ona.
Amharic: ከ14 ቀናት በኋላ እንደ ቴስቶስትሮን ያሉ ሆርሞኖች መጠን ተቀይሮ እንደሆነ ፈትሸው የወንዴ ዘር እጢዎቻቸውን መርምረው የወንዴ ዘራቸውን ቆጠሩ።

English: Using a technique called Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM), they were able to see any changes that occurred in the testicles in detail, down to the level of individual cells.
Luganda: Nga bakozesa enkola y’okukozesa ekitangaaza ne kikuba obuzimbe bw’ekintu obw’omunda (TEM), baasobola okulaba enkyukakyuka zonna ezamerukawo mu nsigo mu bulambulukufu, okutuukira ddala ku butaffaali obwetengeredde.
Yoruba: Nipa lílo ìlànà kan tí à ń pè ní Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM), wọ́n ní àǹfààní láti wo àwọn ìyípadà tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀ nínú ẹpọ̀n lẹ́kùn-ún rẹ́rẹ́, dé ipele ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì kọ̀ọ̀kan.
Zulu: Besebenzisa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi i-Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM), bakwazi ukubona noma yiziphi izinguquko ezenzeka kumasende ngokuningiliziwe, kuze kufike ezingeni lamaseli ngamanye.
Hausa: Ta hanyar amfani da wata dabara mai suna Gani ta Gilashin Ganin Ƙwaƙwaf na Lantarki (TEM), sun sami damar ganin duk wani canje-canje da ya faru a cikin marainan dalla-dalla, har zuwa matakin ɗaiɗaikun sel.
Northern Sotho: Ka go šomišwa mokgwa wo o bitšwago Maekheroskoupu wa Phetošetšo ya Dielektrone (TEM), ba ile ba kgona go bona diphetogo tše di diregilego ka go maretšana ka botlalo, go ya fase maemong a disele ka botšona.
Amharic: ሰደዳ ኤሌክትሮን አጉሊ መነፅርን መጠቀም (ሰ.ኤ.አ) የሚባል ቴክኒክን በመጠቀም በወንዴ ዘር እጢዎቹ ውስጥ የተከሰቱትን ለውጦች እስከ እያንዳንዱ ህዋስ ደረጃ ድረስ በዝርዝር ማየት ችለዋል።

English: The researchers found that the rats injected with vanadium had very low levels of testosterone, and other hormones important for fertility.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula ng’emmese ezaakubibwa ekirungo kya vanadiyamu zaalina homoni za testerone ntono ddala, kw’ossa homoni endala ez’omugaso mu kuzaala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣàwárí pé àwọn eku tí a fún ni abẹ́rẹ́ Fánédíọ̀mù ní ìwọ̀n èròjà-amákọbàlágà tí ó kéré púpọ̀, àti àwọn hòmóònù mìíràn tí ó ṣe pàtàkì sí ìpamọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi amagundane ajovwe nge-vanadium ayenamazinga aphansi kakhulu e-testosterone, namanye amahomoni abalulekile ekuzaleni.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa ɓerayen da aka yi wa allurar sinadarin vanadium suna da ƙarancin matakan testaron, da sauran ƙwayoyin halittar da suke da muhimmanci wajen sa haihuwa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gore magotlo ao a hlabetšwego ka banadiamo a bile le maemo a fase kudu a tšweletšo ya thestosteroune, le ya dihomoune tše dingwe tše bohlokwa tša pelego.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በቫናዲየም የተወጉት አይጦች ቴስቶስትሮን እና ሌሎች ለፍሬአማነት ጠቃሚ የሆኑ ሆርሞኖች በጣም ዝቅተኛ በሆነ መጠን እንዳላቸው ደርሰውበታል።

English: Vanadium-injected rats also had a lot less sperm, and their sperm was less healthy.
Luganda: Emmese ezaakubwa ekirungo kya vanadiyamu era zaalina enkwaso ntono nnyo, ng’ate enkwaso zaazo tezaali nnamu bulungi.
Yoruba: Àwọn eku tí a gún lábẹ́rẹ̀ Fánédíọ̀mù bákan náà ní àtọ̀ tí ó kéré níye, àwọn àtọ̀ wọn kò sì lálàáfíà tó.
Zulu: Amagundane ajovwe nge-Vanadium nawo ayenesidoda esincane kakhulu, futhi isidoda sawo sasinempilo encane.
Hausa: Ɓerayen da aka yi wa allurar sinadarin vanadium su ma suna da ƙarancin maniyyi, kuma maniyyinsu ba shi da lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Magotlo ao a hlabetšwego ka banadiamo le ona a bile le disepeme tše nnyane, gomme disepeme tša ona di be se tša phela gabotse.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በቫናዲየም የተወጉ አይጦች በጣም ያነሰ የወንዴ ዘር ሲኖራቸው የወንዴ ዘራቸው ጤንነት ዝቅ ያለ ነበር።

English: The researchers saw, for example, that some of the rats’ sperm was headless or had a bent tail, and that it didn’t move as much as sperm from the rats injected with water.
Luganda: Okugeza, abanoonyereza baalaba ng’enkwaso z’emmese ezimu tezaalina mutwe oba akakira kaazo kaali keewese, ate era nti tezaatambulanga nnyo ng’enkwaso ezaali mu mmese ezaakubwa amazzi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí rí i, fún àpẹẹrẹ, pé díẹ̀ nínú àtọ̀ àwọn eku náà ni wọn kò ní orí tí ìrù wọn náà sì tún wọ́, pé wọn kò sún lọ títí bíi ti àwọn eku tí a fún lábẹ́rẹ́ omi.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babona, ngokwesibonelo, ukuthi esinye isidoda samagundane sasingenakhanda noma sinomsila ogobile, nokuthi sasingahambi kakhulu njengesidoda esiphuma kumagundane ajovwe ngamanzi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ga, alal misali, cewa wasu maniyyin ɓerayen ba su da kai ko kuma suna da wutsiya lanƙwasasshiya, kuma ba ya motsi kamar maniyyi daga ɓerayen da aka yi wa allura da ruwa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bone, go fa mohlala, gore tše dingwe tša disepeme tša magotlo di be di hloka dihlogo goba di na le mesela ya go kgopama, le gore a be a sa sepele kudu go swana le disepeme le tša magotlo ao a hlabetšwego ka meetse.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ለምሳሌ የአንዳንዶቹ አይጦች የወንዴ ዘር ጭንቅላት አልባ እንደነበር እና የታጠፈ ጅራት እንደነበረው እንዲሁም በውሃ እንደተወጉት አይጦች የወንዴ ዘር ያህል እንደማይንቀሳቀስ ተመልክተዋል።

English: Because sperm are the sex cells of male organisms, used to fertilise eggs in females, these changes would make it more difficult for the rats to successfully breed.
Luganda: Olw’okuba enkwaso bwe butaffaali obuzaazi obw’ebitonde ebisajja, ezikozesebwa okugimusa amagi agali mu bitonde ebikazi, enkyukakyuka zino zaali za zikifuula kizibu emmese zino okuzaala.
Yoruba: Nítorí pé àtọ̀ ni sẹ́ẹ̀lì ìbálòpò nǹkan ọmọkùnrin akọ, tí wọn ń lò láti pa ẹyin nínú àwọn abo, irú ìyípadà báyìí yóò mú kí ó nira fún eku láti ṣàyẹyọrí pipa ọmọ.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi isidoda singamangqamuzana obulili ezinto eziphilayo zesilisa, asetshenziselwa ukuvundisa amaqanda kwabesifazane, lezi zinguquko zingenza kube nzima kakhulu ngamagundane ukuzalanisa ngempumelelo.
Hausa: Domin maniyyin su ne ƙwayoyin halittar maza, waɗanda ake amfani da su wajen haɗa ƙwai a cikin mata, waɗannan canje-canjen za su sa ɓerayen su samu nasarar haihuwa.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge disepeme e le disele tša thobalano tša dipehdinyana tša ditona, tšeo di šomišwago go nontšha mae a ditshadi, diphetogo tše di ka dira gore go be boima kudu gore magotlo a ikoketše ka katlego.
Amharic: የወንዴ ዘሮች በሴቶች ውስጥ ሴቴህዋሶችን ለማስፀነስ የሚያግለግሉ የወንድ ዘአካላት ጾታዊ ህዋሶች ስለሆኑ እነዚህ ለውጦች አይጦቹ በተሳካ ሁኔታ መራባታቸወን አስቸጋሪ ያደርገዋል።

English: Lastly, the researchers found that some of the cells from the rats’ testicles were badly damaged or even destroyed by vanadium.
Luganda: N’ekisembayo, abanoonyereza baazuula ng’obutaffaali obumu mu nsigo z’emmese bwali bukoseddwa bubi nnyo oba oluusi nga busaanyiziddwawo ekirungo kya vanadiyamu.
Yoruba: Ní ìparí, àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ṣàwárí pé díẹ̀ nínú àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì láti ara ẹpọ̀n àwọn eku bàjẹ́ gidigidi, tàbí bàjẹ láti ara Fánédíọ̀mù.
Zulu: Okokugcina, abacwaningi bathola ukuthi amanye amaseli avela emasendeni amagundane wonakaliswe kabi noma acekelwa phansi yi-vanadium.
Hausa: A ƙarshe, masu binciken sun gano cewa wasu ƙwayoyin sel daga marainan ɓerayen sun lalace sosai ko ma sinadarin vanadium ya lalata su.
Northern Sotho: Sa mafelelo, banyakišiši ba ile ba utolla gore tše dingwe tša disele tša maretšana a magotlo di be di senyegile kudu goba di sentšwe ke banadiamo.
Amharic: በመጨረሻም ተመራማሪዎቹ ከአይጦቹ የወንዴ ዘር እጢዎች አንዳንድ ህዋሶች በጣም የተጎዱ ወይም በቫናዲየም የተበላሹ እንደሆኑ ደርሰውበታል።

English: The researchers said that the changes they found could eventually cause complete infertility.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti enkyukakyuka ze baazuula zisobola okuvaamu obugumba obuwedde emirimu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé àwọn àyípadà tí a ṣàwárí wọ̀nyìí lè fa àìlèpamọ pátápátá.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe izinguquko abazitholayo zingagcina zidale ukungabatholi abantwana.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sauye-sauyen da suka gano suna iya haifar da cikakken rashin haihuwa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore diphetogo tšeo ba di hweditšego mafelelong di ka baka go palelwa ke go ikoketša ka botlalo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ባገኙት ለውጥ ውሎ አድሮ ሙሉ በሙሉ መሃንነት ሊያስከትሉ እንደሚችሉ ተናግረዋል።

English: They noted that since animals exposed to vanadium and other pollution in the environment may be unable to reproduce, they could possibly go extinct because of these effects.
Luganda: Baagamba nti engeri gye kiri nti ensolo ezisenseddwa ekirungo kya vanadiyamu awamu n’ebintu ebirala ebyonoona embeerabantu zisobola okulemererwa okuzaala, zisobola okusaanirawo ddala olwa bino ebivaamu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n kíyèsí i pé níwọ̀n ìgbà tí àwọn ẹranko tí wón ṣí sílẹ̀ sí Fánédíọ̀mù àti àwọn ìbàjẹ́ mìíràn nínú àwùjọ lè má lè bísí, wọ́n lè run nítorí àwọn ipa wọ̀nyìí.
Zulu: Baphawule ukuthi njengoba izilwane ezichayeke ku-vanadium nokunye ukungcola endaweni ezungezile zingase zingakwazi ukuzala, kungenzeka ziphele ngenxa yale miphumela.
Hausa: Sun lura cewa tun da dabbobin da aka bayyana su ga sinadarin vanadium da sauran gurɓataccen yanayi a cikin muhalli suna iya kasa haihuwa, wataƙila za su iya ɓacewa saboda waɗannan tasirin.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lemoga gore ka ge diphoofolo tšeo di hlabetšwego ka banadiamo le go tšhilafatšo ye nngwe ya tikologong di palelwa ke go ikoketša, go na le kgonagalo ya gore di ka hwelela ka lebaka la diabe tše.
Amharic: በከባቢ አየር ውስጥ ባለ የቫናዲየም እና ሌላ ብክለት የተጋለጡ እንስሳት መባዛት ሊሳናቸው ስለሚችል በእነዚህ ተጽእኖዎች ምክንያት ሊጠፉ እንደሚችሉ ጠቁመዋል።

English: Because humans are mammals like rats, scientists should also study any possible negative impacts of vanadium in polluted environments on human health.
Luganda: Olw’okuba abantu nabo bagwa mu luse lw’ensolo eziyonsa abaana baazo ng’emmese bwe zikola, bannassaayansi basaanye era banoonyereze ku bulabe bw’ekirungo kya vanadiyamu mu bitundu mwe kisaasaanye eri obulamu bw’abantu.
Yoruba: Nítorí pé àwọn ènìyàn jẹ afọ́mọlọ́yàn bí àwọn eku, ó yẹ kí àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì bákan náà ó ṣe ìwádìí ipa òdì Fánédíọ̀mù lórí ìlera ènìyàn ní àwọn agbègbè tí ó ti díbàjẹ́.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi abantu bayizilwane ezincelisayo njengamagundane, ososayensi kufanele futhi bafunde noma yimiphi imithelela engemihle engaba khona ye-vanadium ezindaweni ezingcolile empilweni yomuntu.
Hausa: Saboda mutane dabbobi masu shayarwa ne kamar ɓeraye, ya kamata masana kimiyya su yi nazarin duk wani mummunan tasirin sinadarin vanadium a cikin gurɓataccen muhalli a kan lafiyar ɗan’adam.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge batho e le diamuši go swana le magotlo, bašomi ba tša mahlale le bona ba swanetše go nyakišiša ka ga kgonagalo efe goba efe ya diabe tša go se loke tša banadiamo ka ditikologong tšeo di šilafetšego go maphelo a batho.
